أنملس (form VII)
# أَنْمَلِسُ (ʔanmalisu) /ʔan.ma.li.su/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْمَلَسَ (inmalasa)
# أَنْمَلِسَ (ʔanmalisa) /ʔan.ma.li.sa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْمَلَسَ (inmalasa)
# أَنْمَلِسْ (ʔanmalis) /ʔan.ma.lis/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْمَلَسَ (inmalasa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
